item.title: Nori 1.8.1
item.description:
### Fixed
- Buying Nori from the app unlocks this Mac at once: no License Key to paste, no second email.

item.title: Nori 1.8.0
item.description:
Nori holds a fifth of the memory it did: on git/git (82,000 commits), 99 MB at rest instead of 523 MB.
### Changed
- The sidebar builds only the branch and tag rows on screen: −180 MB on a repository with 1,000 tags. - The diff page loads when a diff is about to open and is released 3 minutes after the last one closes: no WebKit process until then, −120 MB at rest. - The ambient background is drawn from small images (−80 MB), and the History graph keeps its colours and edges in a fraction of the space (−50 MB on wide graphs). - The app is 31 MB installed instead of 57, and an 11 MB download instead of 14.
### Fixed
- Updating no longer asks for keychain access several times at launch: licensing state lives in a private file, and this update asks at most once.

item.title: Nori 1.7.3
item.description:
### Fixed
- The title bar counts the Trial's days left instead of showing Unlock Nori, and shows nothing once a License is active. - Pushing to the remote's default branch no longer offers to open a pull request.

item.title: Nori 1.7.2
item.description:
### Fixed
- Start 14-day Trial stays offered after Nori's first licence check; it used to disappear on a new Mac. - No more Renew links: every update is included with a License.

item.title: Nori 1.7.1
item.description:
### Changed
- Nori starts a 14-day free Trial on first launch, then needs a License: US$40 once, two Macs, every update included. - While purchases are not open yet, Buy says so instead of reporting an error.

item.title: Nori 1.7.0
item.description:
✦ AI explains commits and diffs, proposes conflict resolutions and summarises requests for review; ⌘K searches the whole history; branches and commits drag and drop. This release also closes the data-loss and security issues found before the public launch.
### Added
- ✦ Explain for a commit or a diff (whole file or one hunk), ✦ Suggest resolution per conflict hunk, and ✦ Summarise for review in Reviews ▸ Overview (never posted); per-use switches and a shared Max context size in Settings ▸ AI. - History search in ⌘K across the whole history, with `author:`, `path:`, `content:`, `regex:`, `before:`, `after:`, `between:` and `hash:` filters, a calendar and value completion; *Show only these in the graph* filters History, 200 per page up to 10,000. - File history (⌘⇧H, 100 commits per page up to 2,000, across renames) and blame (⌘⇧B). - Drag and drop of branches and commits in the sidebar and the graph: merge, rebase, new branch, cherry-pick, revert or push at the drop point. - Checks: a summary bar, required checks listed as Expected, annotations that open their line, GitLab trigger jobs, *Re-run job* and *Re-run failed jobs*, a 30 s refresh while running, counts on the list badge and in the Push menu. - An External editor setting (Xcode, VS Code, Cursor, Zed, Sublime Text, Nova, BBEdit, JetBrains IDEs, any app): *Open in <editor>* ⌘⇧E and *Open Repository in <editor>* ⌃⌥E. - App-wide zoom, ⌘+ and ⌘− from 80 to 150 %, kept across relaunches. - File ▸ Open Repository… and Open Recent; a folder dropped on the Dock icon or given to `open -a Nori` opens as a repository. - Nori ▸ Check for Updates…, release notes in the update window, and a Help menu: website, release notes, Report an Issue (on GitHub), keyboard shortcuts, diagnostic report, privacy policy and terms. - Acknowledgements for the open-source software Nori includes, in About Nori. - Recent crash and hang reports in the exported diagnostic report; nothing is sent.
### Changed
- Nori's bundle identifier is now `app.meetnori.nori` (was `com.nori.desktop`): settings, tabs and recent repositories carry over; macOS asks again for notifications and folder access. - Nori checks for updates automatically, once a day, unless Settings ▸ Updates turns it off; installing stays your call. - ✦ AI tools run in a private empty folder with their tools off, never inside the repository. - Git and its hooks get the login shell's PATH, proxies and SSH agent: nvm, volta, asdf, mise, fnm and MacPorts tools resolve as in Terminal. - Automatic fetch gives way to anything you start, waits until the last fetch is one interval old, backs off up to an hour after failures and never posts a notification. - Quitting while a push, rebase or other Git action runs asks first. - A push refused because the remote has someone else's commits offers Pull, which rebases your commits on theirs, not Force push. - Errors stay on screen until dismissed with ✕ or esc. - Settings ▸ Shortcuts lists every shortcut, and ⌘K shows the keys the menus actually bind. - Reviews says comments are public as soon as you send them, in the composer and in Submit Review. - Reviews offers `glab` for GitLab remotes and `gh` for GitHub, connects every signed-in account (github.com and Enterprise side by side), says Merge Request on GitLab, and binds a remote only to an identity on its host, starting on `upstream`. - Push & PR from a fork with an `upstream` remote opens the request on the parent; on a GitLab remote it reads Push & MR. - Merging asks first when commits were pushed after you opened the request. - Reviews waits for a spent rate limit to reset, and backs off up to 15 minutes after repeated failures. - Merge bar: Checks block only on required checks the forge names; Approvals count against the required number, `1 of 2`. - The Checks tab lists failures first with completion times; GitHub checks are read up to a thousand; GitLab manual jobs count as neutral; Origin says checks are unavailable. - An Overview contributor click adds that author to the History filter. - Stash is back in the top bar, beside Branch: its panel pops, applies or drops a saved stash even with a clean working copy. - Git 2.36 is the minimum version.
### Removed
- Removed syntax colouring for Ada, AutoHotkey v2, gnuplot, nginx, Org and Racket files, and the Aurora X theme: their grammars are GPL-licensed. Those files show as plain text.
### Fixed
- Fixed ✦ actions running a repository's own Claude Code hooks, settings and MCP servers. - Fixed Push & PR publishing a file outside the repository when a pull request template was a symbolic link. - Fixed Open in Default App running scripts, apps and installers from a repository; they open as text or in Finder. - Fixed Force push overwriting commits a background fetch had brought in. - Fixed the branch menu's Push sending a branch started from `origin/main` into `main`, and the upstream dialog offering to delete `origin/main`. - Fixed interactive rebase dropping commits made after its plan opened. - Fixed checkout of a deleted branch wiping edits to a file of the same name, stash Drop, Pop and Apply acting on the wrong stash, and remote branch deletion removing commits pushed since your last fetch. - Fixed a branch being deleted when its Undo snapshot could not be saved. - Fixed Undo snapshots, discarded untracked files included, leaving the machine with `git push --mirror` and showing in `git log --all`: they now live outside the repository, existing ones move there when it opens, and those of repositories never reopened go after 31 days. - Fixed stage and discard acting on the wrong file when a repository's subfolder was opened. - Fixed empty diffs and failed partial staging under Git's `color.ui`, `diff.noprefix` or `apply.whitespace`. - Fixed a commit or push hanging when a hook left a background process running. - Fixed blame on file names outside ASCII. - Fixed unknown SSH hosts, an unaccepted Xcode license and missing Command Line Tools being reported as credential failures. - Fixed Reviews listing only the first 100 files of a GitHub pull request; up to 3,000 now. - Fixed a lost connection leading to a comment, reply, review or merge being sent twice: Nori offers *Check if posted*. - Fixed Reviews' Forget keeping the account's cached data and reconnecting it at the next scan. - Fixed Reviews and Push & PR for SSH remotes using a `~/.ssh/config` alias or a non-standard SSH port. - Fixed one unreadable item (SAML, a missing token permission) blanking a whole Reviews screen. - Fixed an unreadable Reviews store locking Reviews out: it is set aside and a fresh one opens. - Fixed the open request no longer refreshing after Nori came back from the background, and a hidden tab's Reviews still polling. - Fixed "Reconnect required" staying after signing in again, and a new sign-in waiting 30 s after a 401. - Fixed GitLab conversations showing the oldest 50 discussions, GitLab lists stopping at 100 requests, and GitHub Changes and Commits stopping at 100. - Fixed Origin accounts never connecting. - Fixed files with an empty diff showing a loading skeleton forever. - Fixed a crash expanding context in GitLab files with accented names. - Fixed the status bar tooltip showing credentials stored in a remote URL. - Fixed the diff surface keeping every document it drew in memory, and closed tabs staying in memory. - Fixed home screen errors not showing, and "git not found" flashing at launch. - Fixed tabs on a disconnected drive being forgotten at launch. - Fixed VoiceOver reading shortcut symbols as part of button names. - Fixed the notification permission prompt appearing at first launch.
